thread:
maria: Heads up — noticed a weird permissions delta in Console where a Viewer can start a project export if they craft the URL with /export?scope=project_id. Repro on staging and one prod customer report.
aj: whoa, that sounds like a policy scoping bug, not UI. repro steps?
maria: quickly: login as viewer user, hit /projects/123/export?scope=123; button still disabled in UI but backend endpoint autorizes it because the RBAC check used `resource.owner == request.user` fallback that looked up project from path param.
kevin: omg path-based trust. Is this from the recent role-matrix refactor we shipped yesterday?
maria: maybe — I saw the change to ResourceResolver in PR #8421 that switched to lazy lookup. It might be returning null for some flows and the authz code did `if (!resource) return allowIfViewerLookup()` which is wrong.
jessica: can we confirm via audit logs? ops-bot: New audit event: "auth.check" logged for project-export with result=allow, actor=service:console-proxy, subject=viewer:alice, resource=project:123, trace=trace-9ab3
aj: ops-bot — can you pull the full audit chain for trace-9ab3 (KMS key alias, request headers)?
ops-bot: attaching: audit.s3://redwood-audits/2026/03/18/trace-9ab3.json (note: KMS envelope metadata present but key_alias missing for this entry)
sam: missing key_alias is worrying — could mean the KMS wrapper failed to persist metadata when authz used fallback code path. cc @kevin do you think the KMS client change in middleware could be related?
kevin: possibly. Yesterday I added a thin wrapper to avoid double-encrypting small blobs; code path used by lazy resolution might skip the wrapper which also sets `kms_alias` field.
maria: we need an immediate mitigation for prod: deny the export endpoint for Viewer role until fixed. aj: agree. Can we push a short RBAC rule override?
aj: I can push a feature-flagged gate in the proxy: deny /projects/*/export for roles.viewer unless explicit allow in role binding. Patch: ```diff
+if (path.endsWith('/export') && role === 'viewer') return deny('temporary export block for viewer');
```
jessica: also add a streaming audit log entry when deny triggers so we can count attempts.
kevin: I'll open a bug for the resolver + kms wrapper and PR for a proper fix (ensuring resolver always resolves resource or fails closed). PR link: https://git.internal/r/kevin/resolve-fail-closed
maria: good. We should also retroactively scan audit logs for `result=allow` on export endpoints in last 72h and list users who triggered it. ops-bot: scheduled scan job queued: job-5472, ETA 10m.
sam: security triage: classify as P2 since there's no evidence of exfil yet but it's a privilege gap on export. Recommend org-wide notice to CS for the customer report.
aj: rolling the proxy gate now to canary in us-west-2. will post deploy bot updates. :hammer_and_wrench:
ops-bot: deploybot: started rollout canary to us-west-2 for app console-proxy:v2.3.7-canary (id dpl-8821)
maria: after gate live, let's run the audit scan and then coordinate remediation + postmortem owner. I'll own the postmortem.
sam: thanks — ping me when scan completes.
ops-bot: job-5472 completed. Findings: 4 allow events in prod in last 72h, all from staging/proxy-ip 10.8.4.x except one from customer-tenant A. Created incident INC-2026-78 and slack thread #incident-78.
maria: creating the incident bridge now. inviting legal and CS for customer A.
kevin: immediate next steps: 1) revoke viewer-export permission in RBAC store (aj), 2) fix resolver to fail-closed (kevin), 3) ensure kms wrapper always annotates audit entries (kevin), 4) run backfill for missing key_alias in audit (ops), 5) postmortem (maria).
jessica: putting checklist into the incident doc.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll update once the canary is healthy or if we see any additional events. :lock:
